issue.title: Nightly APK schedule never builds — delayed cron dropped by drift window
issue.body:
## Problem

QA / Slack are not getting nightly Fluent APK notices. Last successful EAS `nightly` profile build was **2026-08-27**. Since PR #421 (merged 2026-08-28), scheduled `Nightly Preview` runs still fire twice daily and report **success**, but the APK job only writes “ignored drifted schedule” and never calls EAS.

## Root cause

1. Cron is `17 23 * * *` with `timezone: America/Los_Angeles` (intended ~23:17 PT).
2. GitHub’s scheduler routinely delays that fire until **~04:00–06:00 PT** the next morning.
3. `nightly-windows.cjs` only allows wall-clock hours **22–02 PT**, so every delayed-but-legitimate APK cron is dropped.
4. No APK → no pending Slack artifact → morning Slack job has nothing to post.

Evidence: recent schedule runs complete the APK job in ~20s with “Write drifted-schedule summary”; EAS builds with `buildProfile: nightly` stopped after #421.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When `github.event.schedule` is the APK cron (`17 23 * * *`), the workflow builds (subject to skip-if-unchanged), even if wall-clock PT is outside 22–02.
- [ ] Unknown / legacy schedule strings still use the wall-clock guard (do not rebuild the old ~11am PT false fires).
- [ ] Slack still waits for 09:00–16:00 PT (or morning cron delivery of pending payload).
- [ ] Unit tests cover delayed APK cron acceptance.
- [ ] Docs note that GitHub delay is expected and cron identity is authoritative.

## Out of scope

- Changing EAS profiles or Slack webhook secrets.
- iOS.
